# Markdown Report

> Build Markdown reports with Python.


Tycho Engineering, MIT License

## Pages

- [mdreport](index.html.md): Build Markdown reports programmatically with a chainable API. Add headings, text, lists, callouts, f...
- [Markdown](markdown.html.md): Create a `MarkdownReport`, add content, and then render or save it.
- [Diagrams](diagrams.html.md): Create an SVG diagram in Python, then embed it in a report as a numbered figure.
- [API reference](api-reference.html.md): Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#object)
- [Extensions](extensions.html.md): Create a block when the report methods do not support the content you need.

---

For more comprehensive documentation, see [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)
